glee_cs: Drafting a 1-page "velocity" handoff for Acorn trial tomorrow — focused cache / batch / stream + quick checks. Paste and flag gaps.
glee_cs: TL;DR: cache-first for repeated prompts; batch for many small concurrent calls; stream for interactive UIs. Keep a simple rollback plan.
glee_cs: RUNBOOK (customer-facing, single sheet)
1) Pre-launch checks
- Warm pool: set to ~1.2x projected TPS for first 2h.
- Telemetry owner: platform-observability. Verify p95 latency, 5xx, cache-hit-rate on dashboard.

2) Cache (simple rules)
- Use prefix cache when >25% identical starts. TTLs: 5-15m for session prompts; 12-24h for stable system messages. Use stale-while-revalidate.
- Quick curl test: second identical POST should return header x-cache: HIT.
  curl -s -X POST "https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate" -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -d '{"prompt":"status","cache_key":"acorn_status_v1"}' -i

3) Batching knobs
- For many small requests (<150 tokens) enable batching. Start window=10ms, grow to 50-75ms under load. MaxBatch: 64 on large GPUs, 32 on small.
- Probe traffic: run 200 concurrent small requests during business hours labeled probe=true so we can observe real batch sizes.

4) Streaming tips
- Use streaming for chat UX. Flush partial tokens every 40-80ms or on sentence boundary. If stream drops, retry once after 200ms then call non-stream endpoint.

5) Rollback & graceful degradation
- Fallback order: prod -> quantized fast variant -> smaller-context model.
- Circuit breaker: open if 5xx > 3% over 60s; cool down 30s.
- Rollback trigger: if p95 > 2x baseline for 3 consecutive minutes -> set cache TTL=0 and reduce batch window to 5ms.

6) Quick perf checklist (5-10m)
- Run perf script and record baseline tokens/s and p95 latency.
- Cache smoke: run curl x3 -> expect HIT on 2nd.
- Batch probe: run labeled probe during business hours.
- Stream smoke: open stream, send 3 prompts, confirm partial flush within 100ms.

rafa_cs: LGTM. Add owner for post-call follow-up: I'll post chosen TTLs and batch policy.
ian_sre: Ops note: for Dedicated, cap per-tenant cache entries (suggest max_entries=5000) and enable soft eviction on OOM. Recommend trace sampling 10% for first 48h, then 1%.
mira_eng: Add SDK snippet for batching for engineers to paste:
client.configureBatching({ initialWindowMs:10, maxWindowMs:75, maxBatchSize:64 });
